dogecoin.text:
Reminder: 🚨
 I do not support nor will I ever support another coin. Quit tagging me in pump n dump token's. Tag me all you want in the one and only Dogecoin. 

That is all, have a good rest of your day

@John_Inubook They confuse newcomers, dilute the focus on Dogecoin’s development, and sometimes even compete with it, which undermines the very coin they claim to be associated with. If anything, this parasitic behavior harms Dogecoin rather than supports it.

@John_Inubook Many of these so-called Doge projects like Doge-inspired tokens or spin-offs, often ride on Dogecoin's brand recognition and community goodwill without contributing anything back to the original Dogecoin ecosystem.

@John_Inubook It's highly deceptive because these projects are NOT Dogecoin. I have no issue with people choosing to invest in whatever they like, but exploiting Dogecoin's name or popularity to prop up unrelated projects is absolutely not okay!
